ddl.value: "status" not in ('validated', 'published') or "validated_at" is not null
ddl.name: publication_validated_requires_validation_timestamp

ddl.value:
"status" <> 'published' or (
        "validated_at" is not null
        and "activated_at" is not null
        and "expected_count" = "normalized_count"
        and "normalized_count" = "published_count"
      )
ddl.name: publication_published_requires_gate
